frequency_question: How often do executive-branch trade or regulatory interventions complete the mandatory drafting, interagency review, and formal publication steps within a tight 65-day window?
membership_rule: Includes: Section 232, Section 301, or IEEPA tariff actions announced and brought to formal publication within 90 days. Excludes: multi-year negotiated trade agreements or standard notice-and-comment rulemakings taking over 6 months.
coverage_note: 4 prominent historical precedents analyzed for rapid executive tariff execution.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or sub-sector specific customs adjustments not reaching presidential proclamation level.
skeleton: Major executive tariff actions utilizing emergency or statutory presidential proclamation authority over standard regulatory delays.
multiplier: 3 successful rapid implementations out of 4 documented major historical instances of expedited tariff threats/actions.
validity_reason: Executive statutory authorities regarding tariffs (like Section 232 and IEEPA) remain stable across administrations, though judicial review frameworks evolve slowly.
